sources.entry: Dao Browser - An open-source Chromium-based, Arc-like browser for macOS with a content-first UI, BYOK AI, and MCP support.

summary.one_liner: Dao Browser is a Chromium-based, content-first browser for macOS (Apple Silicon) with an Arc-style vertical tab sidebar and a built-in AI agent that can act on live pages.
summary.what_it_does: Dao is a desktop web browser built on Chromium with a vertical, collapsible tab sidebar that supports folders, favorites, and dual-line active tabs. It includes a floating Spotlight-style command bar with ghost-text completion and an Ask AI entry point (Cmd+L). The built-in tool-calling agent can read, click, scroll, and navigate live pages, shown with an animated cursor and a tab-lock banner. The README also describes long-term memory stored in SQLite with FTS5 across episodic and semantic stores, proactive suggestions triggered by navigation, and a skill system managed at dao://skills. Other features listed are Picture-in-Picture, split view, and Page-to-Markdown capture. The README says BYOK (bring your own key) AI support, but does not detail it beyond that.
use_cases: browse the web with an AI assistant that can act on pages
automate clicking and navigating through websites with an agent
vertical tab management in a minimal browser
keep a picture-in-picture video or split view while browsing
convert a web page to Markdown
build a personal browser agent with reusable skills
how_to_run: Download the macOS arm64 installer from the project's download link
For building from source, follow the development guide referenced in the README
Maintainers: npm run release (builds and uploads both desktop installers on a configured Mac)
npm run release:mac for Mac-only release
npm run release:windows to attach a Windows installer to an existing desktop tag
notable: Tool-calling AI agent that operates live web pages with a visible animated cursor and tab-lock banner
Long-term agent memory using SQLite FTS5 across episodic and semantic stores
Arc-style vertical tab sidebar with folders and favorites
Skill system for extending the agent, managed at dao://skills
caveats: Only macOS arm64 (Apple Silicon) is listed as a supported platform
Building from source and contributing requires the separate development guide, which is not summarized here
Windows installer is only attached to existing releases via a maintainer command
keywords: let ai click and navigate pages
